geometry_analysis.width_description: Nominally uniform, but bead edges are heavily disrupted by void openings
geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Irregularly convex; the continuity of the surface profile is destroyed by heavy pitting

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Extremely dense cluster of deep, elongated, and round cavities covering approximately 80-90% of the visible weld face.
visual_anomalies.visual_severity: Critical / Catastrophic; loss of structural integrity visible

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Where solid metal exists at the toes, the contact angle is steep/abrupt.

surface_state.spatter_distribution: Fine granular spatter on the adjacent base metal
surface_state.discoloration: Metallic grey, dominated by deep black shadows from the high density of voids
